issue_context.title: Make default resource group visible and changable
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
For resource control feature https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/38825 we need to initialize `default` resource group at cluster bootstrap time and make it visible from `information_schema.resource_groups` and support `alter resource group` command.
